<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Mailcow\Tests\Support;

use Mailcow\Imapsync\Http\OAuthClient;

/**
 * OAuthClient without network: resolve() answers from $addresses, send() records the curl options
 * and returns $response.
 */
class FakeOAuthClient extends OAuthClient
{
    /** @var array<string, string[]> host => addresses */
    public array $addresses = [];
    /** @var array{0: string|false, 1: int} */
    public array $response = ['{}', 200];
    /** @var array[] curl options of every send() */
    public array $sent = [];
    /** @var string[] hosts passed to resolve() */
    public array $resolved = [];

    protected function resolve(string $host): array
    {
        $this->resolved[] = $host;
        return $this->addresses[$host] ?? [];
    }

    protected function send(array $options): array
    {
        $this->sent[] = $options;
        return $this->response;
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Mailcow\Tests\ApiKey\Service;

use Mailcow\ApiKey\Model\ApiKey;
use Mailcow\ApiKey\Repository\ApiKeyRepository;
use Mailcow\ApiKey\Service\ApiKeyService;
use Mailcow\Core\Context;
use Mailcow\Core\UserError;
use Mailcow\Tests\Support\FakeContext;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\MockObject\MockObject;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class ApiKeyServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    private const KEY_FORMAT = '/^([0-9A-F]{6}-){4}[0-9A-F]{6}$/';

    private ApiKeyRepository&MockObject $repo;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->repo = $this->createMock(ApiKeyRepository::class);
    }

    private function service(?Context $context = null): ApiKeyService
    {
        return new ApiKeyService($this->repo, $context ?? FakeContext::admin());
    }

    private static function apiContext(string $access): Context
    {
        return new Context('admin', 'API', [], false, $access);
    }

    private static function stored(array $row = []): ApiKey
    {
        return ApiKey:[REDACTED] + ['id' => 3, 'api_key' => 'AAAAAA-BBBBBB-CCCCCC-DDDDDD-EEEEEE', 'description' => 'crm',
            'access' => 'ro', 'allow_from' => '192.0.2.1,2001:db8::/64', 'skip_ip_check' => 0, 'service' => 0, 'active' => 1]);
    }

    private function expectUserError(string|array $msg, callable $call): void
    {
        try {
            $call();
            $this->fail('UserError ' . json_encode($msg) . ' expected');
        } catch (UserError $e) {
            $this->assertSame($msg, $e->msg());
        }
    }

    public static function deniedCallers(): array
    {
        return [
            'domain admin' => [FakeContext::domainAdmin()],
            'user' => [FakeContext::user()],
            'system' => [Context::system()],
            'read-only API key' => [self::apiContext('ro')],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('deniedCallers')]
    public function testOnlyAdminsMayReadOrWrite(Context $context): void
    {
        $this->repo->expects($this->never())->method('all');
        $this->repo->expects($this->never())->method('insert');
        $service = $this->service($context);

        $this->assertSame([], $service->all());
        $this->assertNull($service->get(3));
        $this->expectUserError('access_denied', fn() => $service->create(['access' => 'ro', 'skip_ip_check' => '1']));
        $this->expectUserError('access_denied', fn() => $service->delete(3));
    }

    public function testReadWriteApiKeyMayManageKeys(): void
    {
        $this->repo->method('all')->willReturn([self::stored()]);

        $this->assertCount(1, $this->service(self::apiContext('rw'))->all());
    }

    public function testCreateGeneratesKeyAndNormalisesNetworks(): void
    {
        $this->repo->expects($this->once())->method('insert')->with($this->callback(function (ApiKey $key): bool {
            $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression(self::KEY_FORMAT, $key->key);
            $this->assertSame(['192.0.2.1', '2001:db8::/64', '10.0.0.0/8'], $key->allowFrom);
            $this->assertSame('rw', $key->access);
            $this->assertSame('crm', $key->description);
            $this->assertSame(0, $key->service);
            // Hidden "0" + checked checkbox
            $this->assertSame(1, $key->active);
            $this->assertSame(0, $key->skipIpCheck);
            return true;
        }))->willReturn(7);

        $this->service()->create(['description' => ' crm ', 'access' => 'rw', 'active' => ['0', '1'], 'skip_ip_check' => '0',
            'allow_from' => "192.0.2.1\n2001:db8::/64, 10.0.0.0/8;192.0.2.1"]);
    }

    public function testCreateAcceptsNetworkArray(): void
    {
        $this->repo->expects($this->once())->method('insert')
            ->with($this->callback(fn(ApiKey $key): bool => $key->allowFrom === ['192.0.2.1', '::1']));

        $this->service()->create(['access' => 'ro', 'allow_from' => ['192.0.2.1', ' ::1 ']]);
    }

    public static function invalidInput(): array
    {
        return [
            'access missing' => [['allow_from' => '192.0.2.1'], 'api_key_access_invalid'],
            'access unknown' => [['access' => 'admin', 'allow_from' => '192.0.2.1'], 'api_key_access_invalid'],
            'no network' => [['access' => 'ro'], 'ip_list_empty'],
            'only separators' => [['access' => 'ro', 'allow_from' => " ,\n"], 'ip_list_empty'],
            'hostname' => [['access' => 'ro', 'allow_from' => 'mail.example.org'], ['api_key_network_invalid', 'mail.example.org']],
            'v4 prefix too long' => [['access' => 'ro', 'allow_from' => '192.0.2.0/33'], ['api_key_network_invalid', '192.0.2.0/33']],
            'empty prefix' => [['access' => 'ro', 'allow_from' => '192.0.2.0/'], ['api_key_network_invalid', '192.0.2.0/']],
            'escaped' => [['access' => 'ro', 'allow_from' => '<b>'], ['api_key_network_invalid', '<b>']],
            'description too long' => [['access' => 'ro', 'skip_ip_check' => '1', 'description' => str_repeat('x', 256)], 'api_key_description_invalid'],
            'description array' => [['access' => 'ro', 'skip_ip_check' => '1', 'description' => ['x']], 'api_key_description_invalid'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('invalidInput')]
    public function testCreateRejectsInvalidInput(array $input, string|array $msg): void
    {
        $this->repo->expects($this->never())->method('insert');

        $this->expectUserError($msg, fn() => $this->service()->create($input));
    }

    public function testSkipIpCheckNeedsNoNetwork(): void
    {
        $this->repo->expects($this->once())->method('insert')
            ->with($this->callback(fn(ApiKey $key): bool => $key->skipIpCheck === 1 && $key->allowFrom === []));

        $this->service()->create(['access' => 'ro', 'skip_ip_check' => 'true']);
    }

    public function testUpdateKeepsMissingAttributesAndKeyValue(): void
    {
        $this->repo->method('find')->with(3)->willReturn(self::stored());
        $this->repo->expects($this->once())->method('update')->with($this->callback(function (ApiKey $key): bool {
            $this->assertSame('AAAAAA-BBBBBB-CCCCCC-DDDDDD-EEEEEE', $key->key);
            $this->assertSame(['192.0.2.1', '2001:db8::/64'], $key->allowFrom);
            $this->assertSame('ro', $key->access);
            $this->assertSame('crm', $key->description);
            $this->assertSame(0, $key->active);
            return true;
        }));

        $this->service()->update(3, ['active' => '0']);
    }

    public function testUpdateRegeneratesKey(): void
    {
        $this->repo->method('find')->willReturn(self::stored());
        $this->repo->expects($this->once())->method('update')->with($this->callback(fn(ApiKey $key): bool =>
            preg_match(self::KEY_FORMAT, $key->key) === 1 && $key->key !== 'AAAAAA-BBBBBB-CCCCCC-DDDDDD-EEEEEE'));

        $this->service()->update(3, ['regen_key' => '1']);
    }

    public function testDisablingSkipIpCheckNeedsNetworks(): void
    {
        $this->repo->method('find')->willReturn(self::stored(['allow_from' => '', 'skip_ip_check' => 1]));
        $this->repo->expects($this->never())->method('update');

        $this->expectUserError('ip_list_empty', fn() => $this->service()->update(3, ['skip_ip_check' => '0']));
    }

    public function testServiceKeysAreLocked(): void
    {
        $this->repo->method('find')->willReturn(self::stored(['service' => 1, 'description' => 'API_KEY']));
        $this->repo->expects($this->never())->method('update');
        $this->repo->expects($this->never())->method('delete');

        $this->expectUserError(['api_key_service_locked', 'API_KEY'], fn() => $this->service()->update(3, ['regen_key' => '1']));
        $this->expectUserError(['api_key_service_locked', 'API_KEY'], fn() => $this->service()->delete(3));
    }

    public function testMissingKeyIsAccessDenied(): void
    {
        $this->repo->method('find')->willReturn(null);

        $this->expectUserError('access_denied', fn() => $this->service()->update(99, []));
        $this->expectUserError('access_denied', fn() => $this->service()->delete(99));
    }

    public function testDeleteReturnsDeletedKey(): void
    {
        $this->repo->method('find')->willReturn(self::stored());
        $this->repo->expects($this->once())->method('delete')->with(3);

        $this->assertSame('crm', $this->service()->delete(3)->description);
    }

    public function testSyncMirrorsBothServiceKeys(): void
    {
        $this->repo->expects($this->once())->method('syncService')->with($this->callback(function (array $keys): bool {
            $this->assertCount(2, $keys);
            [$rw, $ro] = $keys;
            $this->assertSame(['RW-KEY', 'API_KEY', 'rw', 1, ['192.0.2.1', '2001:db8::/64']],
                [$rw->key, $rw->description, $rw->access, $rw->service, $rw->allowFrom]);
            $this->assertSame(['RO-KEY', 'API_KEY_READ_ONLY', 'ro', 1, 1, 0],
                [$ro->key, $ro->description, $ro->access, $ro->service, $ro->active, $ro->skipIpCheck]);
            return true;
        }));

        $warnings = $this->service(Context::system())->syncServiceKeys([
            'API_KEY' => 'RW-KEY', 'API_KEY_READ_ONLY' => ' RO-KEY ', 'API_ALLOW_FROM' => '192.0.2.1,2001:db8::/64,nonsense',
        ]);

        $this->assertSame(['API_ALLOW_FROM: skipped invalid IP/network nonsense'], $warnings);
    }

    public static function unsetEnv(): array
    {
        return [
            'compose defaults' => [['API_KEY' => 'invalid', 'API_KEY_READ_ONLY' => 'invalid', 'API_ALLOW_FROM' => 'invalid']],
            'empty' => [['API_KEY' => '', 'API_ALLOW_FROM' => '192.0.2.1']],
            'missing' => [[]],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('unsetEnv')]
    public function testSyncWithoutServiceKeysRemovesThem(array $env): void
    {
        $this->repo->expects($this->once())->method('syncService')->with([]);

        $this->assertSame([], $this->service(Context::system())->syncServiceKeys($env));
    }

    public function testSyncSkipsInvalidKeys(): void
    {
        $this->repo->expects($this->once())->method('syncService')
            ->with($this->callback(fn(array $keys): bool => count($keys) === 1 && $keys[0]->description === 'API_KEY'));

        $warnings = $this->service(Context::system())->syncServiceKeys([
            'API_KEY' => 'SAME-KEY', 'API_KEY_READ_ONLY' => 'SAME-KEY', 'API_ALLOW_FROM' => '192.0.2.1',
        ]);
        $this->assertSame(['API_KEY_READ_ONLY: same value as API_KEY, key ignored'], $warnings);

        $this->repo = $this->createMock(ApiKeyRepository::class);
        $this->repo->expects($this->once())->method('syncService')->with([]);
        $warnings = $this->service(Context::system())->syncServiceKeys(['API_KEY' => 'bad"key', 'API_KEY_READ_ONLY' => 'RO-KEY',
            'API_ALLOW_FROM' => 'invalid']);
        $this->assertSame([
            'API_KEY: invalid characters (allowed: a-z, A-Z, 0-9, -), key ignored',
            'API_KEY_READ_ONLY: API_ALLOW_FROM contains no valid IP/network, key ignored',
        ], $warnings);
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Mailcow\Tests\Auth\Service;

use Exception;
use LdapRecord\Auth\BindException;
use LdapRecord\Auth\Guard;
use LdapRecord\Connection;
use LdapRecord\ConnectionException;
use LdapRecord\DetailedError;
use Mailcow\Auth\IdpUnavailable;
use Mailcow\Auth\Service\IdpLoginService;
use Mailcow\Identity\Model\Settings;
use Mailcow\Identity\Service\LinkService;
use Mailcow\MailboxGroup\Service\TemplateService;
use PDOException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class IdpLoginServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testLinkErrorsDenyTheLogin(): void
    {
        $links = $this->createMock(LinkService::class);
        $links->method('verify')->willThrowException(new PDOException('gone'));
        $links->method('mayCreate')->willThrowException(new PDOException('gone'));
        $links->method('link')->willThrowException(new PDOException('gone'));
        $login = new IdpLoginService(Settings::fromArray([]), $links, $this->createMock(TemplateService::class));

        $this->assertFalse($login->verifyLink('keycloak', 'a@example.org', 'u1'));
        $this->assertFalse($login->mayCreate('keycloak', 'a@example.org', 'u1'));
        $login->storeLink('keycloak', 'a@example.org', 'u1');
    }

    public function testLinkChecksArePassedOn(): void
    {
        $links = $this->createMock(LinkService::class);
        $links->method('verify')->with('ldap', 'a@example.org', 'guid-1')->willReturn(true);
        $links->method('mayCreate')->with('ldap', 'b@example.org', 'guid-2')->willReturn(false);
        $links->expects($this->once())->method('link')->with('ldap', 'c@example.org', 'guid-3');
        $login = new IdpLoginService(Settings::fromArray([]), $links, $this->createMock(TemplateService::class));

        $this->assertTrue($login->verifyLink('ldap', 'a@example.org', 'guid-1'));
        $this->assertFalse($login->mayCreate('ldap', 'b@example.org', 'guid-2'));
        $login->storeLink('ldap', 'c@example.org', 'guid-3');
    }

    public function testGroupTemplateWinsAndErrorsFallBackToTheMapping(): void
    {
        $templates = $this->createMock(TemplateService::class);
        $templates->method('templateForLogin')->willReturnCallback(function (string $username, ?string $mapped): ?string {
            if ($username === 'broken@example.org') {
                throw new PDOException('gone');
            }
            return 'Group';
        });
        $login = new IdpLoginService(Settings::fromArray([]), $this->createMock(LinkService::class), $templates);

        $this->assertSame('Group', $login->templateFor('a@example.org', 'Staff'));
        $this->assertSame('Staff', $login->templateFor('broken@example.org', 'Staff'));
    }

    public function testMappingTakesSingleValuesAndLists(): void
    {
        $settings = Settings::fromArray(['mappers' => ['default', 'sales'], 'templates' => ['Staff', 'Sales']]);
        $login = new IdpLoginService($settings, $this->createMock(LinkService::class), $this->createMock(TemplateService::class));

        $this->assertSame('Staff', $login->mappedTemplate('default'));
        $this->assertSame('Sales', $login->mappedTemplate(['other', 'sales']));
        $this->assertNull($login->mappedTemplate(null));
        $this->assertNull($login->mappedTemplate(['unknown']));
    }

    public function testLdapPasswordIsCheckedWithABindAsTheUser(): void
    {
        $guard = $this->createMock(Guard::class);
        $guard->expects($this->once())->method('bind')->with('uid=a,dc=example,dc=org', 'secret');
        $guard->expects($this->once())->method('bindAsConfiguredUser');

        $this->assertTrue($this->login()->verifyLdapPassword($this->ldap($guard), 'uid=a,dc=example,dc=org', 'secret'));
    }

    public function testWrongLdapPassword(): void
    {
        $guard = $this->createMock(Guard::class);
        $guard->method('bind')->willThrowException($this->bindError(49, 'Invalid credentials'));
        $guard->expects($this->once())->method('bindAsConfiguredUser');

        $this->assertFalse($this->login()->verifyLdapPassword($this->ldap($guard), 'uid=a,dc=example,dc=org', 'wrong'));
    }

    public function testEmptyLdapPasswordNeverBinds(): void
    {
        $guard = $this->createMock(Guard::class);
        $guard->expects($this->never())->method('bind');

        $this->assertFalse($this->login()->verifyLdapPassword($this->ldap($guard), 'uid=a,dc=example,dc=org', ''));
    }

    public static function ldapOutages(): array
    {
        return [
            'server down' => [-1, "Can't contact LDAP server"],
            'timeout' => [-5, 'Timed out'],
            'busy' => [51, 'Busy'],
            'unavailable' => [52, 'Unavailable'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('ldapOutages')]
    public function testLdapOutageIsNoWrongPassword(int $code, string $message): void
    {
        $guard = $this->createMock(Guard::class);
        $guard->method('bind')->willThrowException($this->bindError($code, $message));

        $this->expectException(IdpUnavailable::class);
        $this->login()->verifyLdapPassword($this->ldap($guard), 'uid=a,dc=example,dc=org', 'secret');
    }

    public function testFailedStartTlsIsAnOutage(): void
    {
        $guard = $this->createMock(Guard::class);
        $guard->method('bind')->willThrowException(new ConnectionException('Unable to connect'));

        $this->expectException(IdpUnavailable::class);
        $this->login()->verifyLdapPassword($this->ldap($guard), 'uid=a,dc=example,dc=org', 'secret');
    }

    private function login(): IdpLoginService
    {
        return new IdpLoginService(Settings::fromArray([]), $this->createMock(LinkService::class), $this->createMock(TemplateService::class));
    }

    private function ldap(Guard $guard): Connection
    {
        $ldap = $this->createMock(Connection::class);
        $ldap->method('auth')->willReturn($guard);
        return $ldap;
    }

    private function bindError(int $code, string $message): BindException
    {
        return BindException::withDetailedError(new Exception($message, $code), new DetailedError($code, $message, null));
    }
}

namespace Mailcow\Tests\Identity\Service;

use Mailcow\Identity\Repository\IdentityRepository;
use Mailcow\Identity\Service\LinkService;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class LinkServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testLinkedMailboxNeedsTheLinkedUser(): void
    {
        $repo = $this->createMock(IdentityRepository::class);
        $repo->method('findLink')->willReturn(['provider' => 'keycloak', 'external_id' => 'u1', 'idp_disabled' => 0, 'missing_since' => null]);
        $repo->expects($this->never())->method('link');
        $login = new LinkService($repo);

        $this->assertTrue($login->verify('keycloak', 'a@example.org', 'u1'));
        $this->assertFalse($login->verify('keycloak', 'a@example.org', 'u2'));
        $this->assertFalse($login->verify('keycloak', 'a@example.org', ''));
    }

    public function testUnlinkedMailboxIsLinkedOnLogin(): void
    {
        $repo = $this->createMock(IdentityRepository::class);
        $repo->method('findLink')->willReturn(['provider' => 'keycloak', 'external_id' => null, 'idp_disabled' => 1, 'missing_since' => null]);
        $repo->method('usernameOf')->willReturn(null);
        $repo->expects($this->once())->method('link')->with('a@example.org', 'keycloak', 'u1');

        $this->assertTrue((new LinkService($repo))->verify('keycloak', 'a@example.org', 'u1'));
    }

    public function testUserOfAnotherMailboxIsDenied(): void
    {
        $repo = $this->createMock(IdentityRepository::class);
        $repo->method('findLink')->willReturn(null);
        $repo->method('usernameOf')->with('ldap', 'guid-1')->willReturn('old@example.org');
        $repo->expects($this->never())->method('link');
        $login = new LinkService($repo);

        $this->assertFalse($login->verify('ldap', 'new@example.org', 'guid-1'));
        $this->assertFalse($login->mayCreate('ldap', 'new@example.org', 'guid-1'));
        $this->assertTrue($login->mayCreate('ldap', 'old@example.org', 'guid-1'));
    }

    public function testLinkOfAnotherProviderIsReplaced(): void
    {
        $repo = $this->createMock(IdentityRepository::class);
        $repo->method('findLink')->willReturn(['provider' => 'ldap', 'external_id' => 'guid-1', 'idp_disabled' => 0, 'missing_since' => null]);
        $repo->method('usernameOf')->willReturn(null);
        $repo->expects($this->once())->method('link')->with('a@example.org', 'keycloak', 'u1');

        $this->assertTrue((new LinkService($repo))->verify('keycloak', 'a@example.org', 'u1'));
    }
}

class StatusServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testAdminRequestsRuns(): void
    {
        $runs = $this->createMock(RunRepository::class);
        $runs->expects($this->once())->method('request')->with('keycloak', 'force', 'admin')->willReturn(5);

        $this->assertSame(5, $this->service(FakeContext::admin(), $runs)->requestRun('force'));
    }

    public function testInvalidModeIsRejected(): void
    {
        $this->expectExceptionObject(new UserError('iam_sync_mode_invalid'));
        $this->service(FakeContext::admin())->requestRun(['run']);
    }

    public function testReadOnlyApiMayOnlyRead(): void
    {
        $service = $this->service(new Context('admin', 'api', [], false, 'ro'));

        $this->assertSame('keycloak', $service->status()['provider']);
        $this->expectException(AccessDenied::class);
        $service->requestRun('run');
    }

    public function testDomainAdminsSeeOnlyLinksOfTheirMailboxes(): void
    {
        $repo = $this->createMock(IdentityRepository::class);
        $repo->method('findLink')->willReturn(['provider' => 'keycloak', 'external_id' => 'u1', 'idp_disabled' => 0, 'missing_since' => null]);
        $service = $this->service(FakeContext::domainAdmin(['a@example.org']), null, $repo);

        $this->expectException(AccessDenied::class);
        $this->service(FakeContext::domainAdmin(['a@example.org']), null, $repo)->unlink('a@example.org');
    }

    private function service(Context $context, ?RunRepository $runs = null, ?IdentityRepository $repo = null): StatusService
    {
        return new StatusService(Settings::fromArray(['authsource' => 'keycloak']), $repo ?? $this->createMock(IdentityRepository::class),
            $runs ?? $this->createMock(RunRepository::class), $context);
    }
}

namespace Mailcow\Tests\Identity\Service;

use Mailcow\Identity\Model\Account;

use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class SyncPlannerTest extends TestCase
{
    private const SINCE = '2026-10-25 10:00:00';

    public function testUnlinkedMailboxIsAdoptedByEmail(): void
    {
        $plan = $this->plan([self::user('u1', 'a@example.org')], [new Account('a@example.org', 'A', 1)]);

        $this->assertSame(['a@example.org' => 'u1'], $plan->links);
        $this->assertSame([], $plan->conflicts);
    }

    public function testUnlinkedMailboxWithSeveralIdpUsersIsNeitherLinkedNorOffboarded(): void
    {
        $users = [self::user('u1', 'a@example.org'), self::user('u2', 'a@example.org', false), self::user('u3', 'a@example.org')];
        $plan = $this->plan($users, [new Account('a@example.org', 'A', 1)]);

        $this->assertSame([], $plan->links);
        $this->assertSame(['Several IdP users have the email a@example.org'], $plan->conflicts);
        $this->assertSame([], $plan->missing);
        $this->assertSame([], $plan->deactivate);
    }

    {
        $settings = ['periodic_sync' => 1, 'mappers' => ['staff'], 'templates' => ['Staff']];
        $accounts = [new Account('a@example.org', 'A', 1, 'u1', false, null, 'h-staff'),
            new Account('b@example.org', 'B', 1, 'u2', false, null, 'h-old'),
            new Account('c@example.org', 'C', 1, 'u3', false, null, 'h-staff'),
            new Account('d@example.org', 'D', 1, 'u4', false, null, 'h-staff')];
        $users = [self::user('u1', 'a@example.org', true, ['staff'], 'A'), self::user('u2', 'b@example.org', true, ['staff'], 'B'),
            self::user('u3', 'c@example.org', true, ['staff'], 'C New'), self::user('u4', 'd@example.org', true, ['staff'])];
        $state = ['hashes' => ['Staff' => 'h-staff', 'Sales' => 'h-sales'], 'effective' => ['a@example.org' => 'Sales']];
        $plan = $this->plan($users, $accounts, $settings, $state);

        $this->assertSame([
            ['username' => 'a@example.org', 'name' => 'A', 'template' => 'Staff'],
            ['username' => 'b@example.org', 'name' => 'B', 'template' => 'Staff'],
            ['username' => 'c@example.org', 'name' => 'C New', 'template' => 'Staff'],
        ], $plan->updates);
    }

    private function plan(array $users, array $accounts, array $settings = [], array $state = [], ?array $groups = null, bool $force = false)
    {
        $byId = [];
        foreach ($users as $user) {
            $byId[$user->id] = $user;
        }
        $groupsById = null;
        if ($groups !== null) {
            $groupsById = [];
            foreach ($groups as $group) {
                $groupsById[$group->id] = $group;
            }
        }
        $byName = [];
        foreach ($accounts as $account) {
            $byName[$account->username] = $account;
        }
        return (new SyncPlanner())->plan(
            Settings::fromArray($settings + ['authsource' => 'keycloak', 'offboarding' => 1, 'import_users' => 1]),
            new Listing($byId, $groupsById),
            new State($byName, array_fill_keys(array_keys($byName), 'keycloak') + ($state['mailboxes'] ?? []),
                $state['domains'] ?? ['example.org'], $state['groups'] ?? [], $state['effective'] ?? [], $state['hashes'] ?? []),
            $force);
    }

    private static function user(string $id, ?string $email, bool $enabled = true, array $templates = [], string $name = ''): DirectoryUser
    {
        return new DirectoryUser($id, $email, $name, $enabled, $templates);
    }

    private static function group(int $id, ?string $ref, string $name, array $members, ?string $template = null, int $priority = 0): array
    {
        return ['id' => $id, 'domain' => 'example.org', 'name' => $name, 'idp_ref' => $ref, 'template' => $template,
            'priority' => $priority, 'active' => 1, 'members' => $members];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Mailcow\Imapsync\Service\OAuthService;

use PHPUnit\Framework\MockObject\MockObject;

class OAuthServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    private SourceRepository&MockObject $sources;
    private TokenRepository&MockObject $tokens;
    private OAuthClient&MockObject $client;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->sources = $this->createMock(SourceRepository::class);
        $this->tokens = $this->createMock(TokenRepository::class);
        $this->client = $this->createMock(OAuthClient::class);
    }

    private function service(string $hostname = 'Mail.Example.org '): OAuthService
    {
        return new OAuthService($this->sources, $this->tokens, $this->client, $hostname);
    }

    private static function source(array $row = []): Source
    {
        return Source::fromRow($row + [
            'id' => 4, 'name' => 'm365', 'created_by' => 'da', 'host1' => 'outlook.office365.com', 'port1' => 993,
            'auth_type' => 'XOAUTH2', 'oauth_flow' => 'client_credentials', 'active' => 1,
            'oauth_token_endpoint' => 'https://login.example.org/token', 'oauth_authorize_endpoint' => 'https://login.example.org/authorize?tenant=x',
            'oauth_userinfo_endpoint' => 'https://login.example.org/userinfo',
            'oauth_client_id' => 'client', 'oauth_client_secret' => 'secret', 'oauth_scope' => 'scope',
        ]);
    }

    private static function userToken(array $row = []): OAuthToken
    {
        return OAuthToken:[REDACTED] + ['source_id' => 4, 'owner' => 'local@example.org', 'username' => 'remote@example.net',
            'refresh_token' => 'old-refresh', 'access_token' => 'old-access']);
    }

    public function testRedirectUriUsesMailcowHostnameOnly(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('https://mail.example.org/syncjob-oauth', $this->service()->redirectUri());
        $this->assertSame('', $this->service('')->redirectUri());
    }

    public function testEndpointsOfAdminSourcesAreNotAddressRestricted(): void
    {
        $this->sources->method('isSuperAdmin')->willReturnMap([['admin', true], ['da', false]]);
        $this->client->expects($this->exactly(3))->method('isAllowed')
            ->willReturnCallback(fn(string $url, bool $strict): bool => !$strict);
        $service = $this->service();

        foreach (['admin' => true, 'API' => true, 'da' => false] as $createdBy => $allowed) {
            $source = self::source(['created_by' => $createdBy, 'oauth_flow' => 'authorization_code']);
            $this->assertSame($allowed, $service->authorizeUrl($source, 'state') !== null, $createdBy);
        }
    }

    public function testAuthorizeUrl(): void
    {
        $this->client->method('isAllowed')->willReturnOnConsecutiveCalls(true, false);
        $source = self::source(['oauth_flow' => 'authorization_code']);

        $this->assertSame('https://login.example.org/authorize?tenant=x&prompt=select_account&client_id=client&response_type=code'
            . '&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fmail.example.org%2Fsyncjob-oauth&response_mode=query&scope=scope&state=abc',
            $this->service()->authorizeUrl($source, 'abc'));
        $this->assertNull($this->service()->authorizeUrl($source, 'abc'));
    }

    public function testSignInParamsGoToTheAuthorizeUrlOnly(): void
    {
        $this->client->method('isAllowed')->willReturn(true);
        $this->client->expects($this->once())->method('request')->with(
            'https://login.example.org/token',
            true,
            ['resource' => 'r', 'client_id' => 'client', 'client_secret' => 'secret', 'scope' => 'scope', 'grant_type' => 'client_credentials']
        )->willReturn(['access_token' => 'new']);
        $extra = '{"prompt":"consent select_account","access_type":"offline","resource":"r"}';

        // prompt overrides the default; sign-in params never reach the token endpoint and vice versa
        $this->assertSame('https://login.example.org/authorize?tenant=x&prompt=consent+select_account&access_type=offline&client_id=client'
            . '&response_type=code&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fmail.example.org%2Fsyncjob-oauth&response_mode=query&scope=scope&state=abc',
            $this->service()->authorizeUrl(self::source(['oauth_flow' => 'authorization_code', 'oauth_extra_params' => $extra]), 'abc'));
        $this->assertNull($this->service()->refreshSourceToken(self::source(['oauth_extra_params' => $extra])));
    }

    public function testClientCredentialsRefreshStoresToken(): void
    {
        $this->client->expects($this->once())->method('request')->with(
            'https://login.example.org/token',
            true,
            ['resource' => 'r', 'client_id' => 'client', 'client_secret' => 'secret', 'scope' => 'scope', 'grant_type' => 'client_credentials']
        )->willReturn(['access_token' => 'new', 'expires_in' => '120']);
        $this->tokens->expects($this->once())->method('storeSourceToken')->with(4, 'new', $this->callback(
            fn(int $expires): bool => abs($expires - (time() + 120)) <= 2
        ));

        // Stored extra params never override the client and grant fields
        $source = self::source(['oauth_extra_params' => '{"resource":"r","client_id":"evil","grant_type":"password"}']);
        $this->assertNull($this->service()->refreshSourceToken($source));
    }

    public function testFailedRefreshStoresTheSanitisedError(): void
    {
        $this->client->method('request')->willThrowException(new OAuthException('HTTP 401: invalid_client'));
        $this->tokens->expects($this->once())->method('storeSourceError')->with(4, 'HTTP 401: invalid_client');
        $this->tokens->expects($this->never())->method('storeSourceToken');

        $this->assertSame('HTTP 401: invalid_client', $this->service()->refreshSourceToken(self::source()));
    }

    public function testTokenResponseWithoutAccessTokenIsMalformed(): void
    {
        $this->client->method('request')->willReturn(['access_token' => ['x']]);
        $this->tokens->expects($this->once())->method('storeSourceError')->with(4, 'malformed token response');

        $this->assertSame('malformed token response', $this->service()->refreshSourceToken(self::source()));
    }

    public function testOnlyClientCredentialsSourcesHaveASourceToken(): void
    {
        $this->client->expects($this->never())->method('request');

        $this->assertSame('not refreshable', $this->service()->refreshSourceToken(self::source(['oauth_flow' => 'authorization_code'])));
    }

    public function testUserRefreshKeepsRefreshTokenWhenProviderSendsNone(): void
    {
        $source = self::source(['oauth_flow' => 'authorization_code']);
        $this->client->method('request')->willReturnOnConsecutiveCalls(
            ['access_token' => 'a1'],
            ['access_token' => 'a2', 'refresh_token' => 'r2', 'expires_in' => 60]
        );
        $stored = [];
        $this->tokens->method('storeUserRefresh')->willReturnCallback(function (OAuthToken $t) use (&$stored): void {
            $stored[] = [$t->accessToken, $t->refreshToken, $t->tokenExpires - time()];
        });

        $this->assertNull($this->service()->refreshUserToken($source, self::userToken()));
        $this->assertNull($this->service()->refreshUserToken($source, self::userToken()));

        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta([['a1', 'old-refresh', 3600], ['a2', 'r2', 60]], $stored, 2);
    }

    public function testUserRefreshFailureIsStoredOnTheToken(): void
    {
        $this->client->method('request')->willThrowException(new OAuthException('HTTP 400: invalid_grant'));
        $this->tokens->expects($this->once())->method('storeUserError')->with($this->isInstanceOf(OAuthToken::class), 'HTTP 400: invalid_grant');

        $this->assertSame('HTTP 400: invalid_grant',
            $this->service()->refreshUserToken(self::source(['oauth_flow' => 'authorization_code']), self::userToken()));
        $this->assertSame('not refreshable',
            $this->service()->refreshUserToken(self::source(['oauth_flow' => 'authorization_code']), self::userToken(['refresh_token' => ''])));
    }

    public function testRefreshDueAppliesExpiryAndRetryRules(): void
    {
        // due 20 min ahead, retried 3 min after a failure
        $soon = time() + 1100;
        $this->tokens->method('refreshableSources')->willReturn([
            self::source(['id' => 1, 'name' => 'no token']),
            self::source(['id' => 2, 'name' => 'valid', 'oauth_token_expires' => time() + 1300]),
            self::source(['id' => 3, 'name' => 'failed recently', 'oauth_token_expires' => $soon, 'oauth_last_refresh_error' => 'HTTP 500', 'refresh_attempt_age' => 180]),
            self::source(['id' => 4, 'name' => 'failed long ago', 'oauth_token_expires' => $soon, 'oauth_last_refresh_error' => 'HTTP 500', 'refresh_attempt_age' => 181]),
        ]);
        $this->tokens->method('deleteUnusedOlderThan')->with(86400)->willReturn(0);
        $this->tokens->method('refreshableUserTokens')->willReturn([]);
        $this->client->expects($this->exactly(2))->method('request')->willReturnOnConsecutiveCalls(
            ['access_token' => 't'],
            $this->throwException(new OAuthException('HTTP 401: invalid_client'))
        );

        $this->assertSame([
            ['priority' => 'info', 'message' => "Refreshed token for source 'no token' (id=1)"],
            ['priority' => 'warning', 'message' => "Refresh failed for source 'failed long ago' (id=4): HTTP 401: invalid_client"],
        ], $this->service()->refreshDue());
    }

    public function testRefreshDueCleansUpAndRefreshesUserTokens(): void
    {
        $source = self::source(['oauth_flow' => 'authorization_code']);
        $this->tokens->method('refreshableSources')->willReturn([]);
        $this->tokens->method('deleteUnusedOlderThan')->willReturn(2);
        $this->tokens->method('refreshableUserTokens')->willReturn([
            self::userToken(),
            self::userToken(['username' => 'fresh@example.net', 'token_expires' => time() + 3600]),
            self::userToken(['username' => 'db@example.net']),
            self::userToken(['source_id' => 99, 'username' => 'orphan@example.net']),
        ]);
        $this->sources->method('find')->willReturnMap([[4, $source], [99, null]]);
        $this->client->method('request')->willReturn(['access_token' => 'new']);
        $this->tokens->method('storeUserRefresh')->willReturnOnConsecutiveCalls(null, $this->throwException(new PDOException('lost')));

        $this->assertSame([
            ['priority' => 'info', 'message' => 'Removed 2 unused user token(s)'],
            ['priority' => 'info', 'message' => "Refreshed user token 'remote@example.net' (mailbox local@example.org) on source 'm365' (id=4)"],
            ['priority' => 'warning', 'message' => "Refresh failed for user token 'db@example.net' (mailbox local@example.org) on source 'm365' (id=4): PDOException"],
            ['priority' => 'warning', 'message' => "Refresh failed for user token 'orphan@example.net' (mailbox local@example.org) on source '' (id=99): not refreshable"],
        ], $this->service()->refreshDue());
    }

    public function testConnectUserTakesIdentityFromIdToken(): void
    {
        $claims = rtrim(strtr(base64_encode(json_encode(['preferred_username' => 'not an address', 'upn' => 'Remote@Example.NET'])), '+/', '-_'), '=');
        $this->client->expects($this->once())->method('request')->with(

    public function testConnectUserFallsBackToUserinfo(): void
    {
        $this->client->method('request')->willReturnOnConsecutiveCalls(

    public function testConnectUserErrors(): void
    {
        $source = self::source(['oauth_flow' => 'authorization_code']);
        $this->client->method('request')->willReturnOnConsecutiveCalls(
            $this->throwException(new OAuthException('HTTP 400: invalid_grant')),
            ['access_token' => 'acc'],
            $this->throwException(new OAuthException('HTTP 401')),
            ['access_token' => 'acc', 'id_token' => 'not.a.jwt.at.all']
        );
        $this->tokens->expects($this->never())->method('saveUserToken');

        $this->assertUserError(['token_failed', 'token exchange failed for source 4: HTTP 400: invalid_grant'], fn() => $this->service()->connectUser($source, 'o', 'c'));
        $this->assertUserError('no_identity', fn() => $this->service()->connectUser($source, 'o', 'c'));

    public function testConnectUserReportsStorageFailure(): void
    {

    private function assertUserError(string|array $msg, callable $call): void
    {

            $this->fail('UserError expected');
        } catch (UserError $e) {

        $id = $this->addAppPasswd(['imap_access' => 1]);

        $this->assertEquals($id, $_SESSION['app_passwd_id']);

    private function addMailbox(array $mailbox, int $domainActive): void
    {
        $attributes = array_merge(array_fill_keys(self::PROTOCOLS, '1'), ['shared' => '0'], $mailbox['attributes'] ?? []);
        $this->pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO `domain` (`domain`, `active`) VALUES ('example.org', ?)")->execute([$domainActive]);
        $this->pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO `mailbox` (`username`, `domain`, `kind`, `active`, `attributes`) VALUES ('user@example.org', 'example.org', ?, ?, ?)")
            ->execute([$mailbox['kind'] ?? '', $mailbox['active'] ?? 1, json_encode($attributes)]);

    private function addAppPasswd(array $appPasswd, string $password = 'app-secret'): int
    {
        $row = array_merge(array_fill_keys(self::PROTOCOLS, 0), ['active' => 1], $appPasswd);
        $hash = '{BLF-CRYPT}' . password_hash($password, PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 4]);
        $this->pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO `app_passwd` (`name`, `mailbox`, `password`, " . implode(', ', array_map(fn ($c) => "`$c`", array_keys($row))) . ")
            VALUES ('test', 'user@example.org', ?, " . implode(', ', array_fill(0, count($row), '?')) . ")")
            ->execute(array_merge([$hash], array_values($row)));
        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

/**
 * Keycloak admin API in memory: routes are paths below the realm with a list (paged by first/max) or an HTTP status.
 */
class FakeKeycloakClient extends KeycloakClient
{
    public int $tokens = 0;
    private array $requests = [];

    public function __construct(private array $routes, private int $rejectTokens = 0)
    {
        parent::__construct('https://kc.example.org', 'mailcow', 'mailcow', 'secret');
    }

    /** @return string[] requested paths with query, token requests excluded */
    public function paths(): array
    {
        return $this->requests;
    }

    protected function send(string $method, string $url, array $headers, ?string $body): array
    {
        if (str_ends_with($url, '/protocol/openid-connect/token')) {
            $this->tokens++;
            return [200, json_encode(['access_token' => 'token' . $this->tokens])];
        }
        if ($this->rejectTokens > 0 && in_array('Authorization: Bearer token1', $headers, true)) {
            return [401, ''];
        }
        $path = substr((string)parse_url($url, PHP_URL_PATH), strlen('/admin/realms/mailcow'));
        parse_str((string)parse_url($url, PHP_URL_QUERY), $query);
        $this->requests[] = $path . '?' . http_build_query($query);
        $route = $this->routes[$path] ?? 404;
        if (is_int($route)) {
            return [$route, ''];
        }
        return [200, json_encode(array_slice($route, (int)($query['first'] ?? 0), (int)($query['max'] ?? count($route))))];
    }
}

<?php

namespace lbuchs\WebAuthn\Attestation;
use lbuchs\WebAuthn\WebAuthnException;
use lbuchs\WebAuthn\CBOR\CborDecoder;
use lbuchs\WebAuthn\Binary\ByteBuffer;

/**
 * @author Lukas Buchs
 * @license https://github.com/lbuchs/WebAuthn/blob/master/LICENSE MIT
 */
class AuthenticatorData {
    protected $_binary;
    protected $_rpIdHash;
    protected $_flags;
    protected $_signCount;
    protected $_attestedCredentialData;
    protected $_extensionData;



    // Cose encoded keys
    private static $_COSE_KTY = 1;
    private static $_COSE_ALG = 3;

    // Cose EC2 ES256 P-256 curve
    private static $_COSE_CRV = -1;
    private static $_COSE_X = -2;
    private static $_COSE_Y = -3;

    // Cose RSA PS256
    private static $_COSE_N = -1;
    private static $_COSE_E = -2;

    private static $_EC2_TYPE = 2;
    private static $_EC2_ES256 = -7;
    private static $_EC2_P256 = 1;

    private static $_RSA_TYPE = 3;
    private static $_RSA_RS256 = -257;

    /**
     * Parsing the authenticatorData binary.
     * @param string $binary
     * @throws WebAuthnException
     */
    public function __construct($binary) {
        if (!\is_string($binary) || \strlen($binary) < 37) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('Invalid authenticatorData input', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }
        $this->_binary = $binary;

        // Read infos from binary
        // https://www.w3.org/TR/webauthn/#sec-authenticator-data

        // RP ID
        $this->_rpIdHash = \substr($binary, 0, 32);

        // flags (1 byte)
        $flags = \unpack('Cflags', \substr($binary, 32, 1))['flags'];
        $this->_flags = $this->_readFlags($flags);

        // signature counter: 32-bit unsigned big-endian integer.
        $this->_signCount = \unpack('Nsigncount', \substr($binary, 33, 4))['signcount'];

        $offset = 37;
        // https://www.w3.org/TR/webauthn/#sec-attested-credential-data
        if ($this->_flags->attestedDataIncluded) {
            $this->_attestedCredentialData = $this->_readAttestData($binary, $offset);
        }

        if ($this->_flags->extensionDataIncluded) {
            $this->_readExtensionData(\substr($binary, $offset));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Authenticator Attestation Globally Unique Identifier, a unique number
     * that identifies the model of the authenticator (not the specific instance
     * of the authenticator)
     * The aaguid may be 0 if the user is using a old u2f device and/or if
     * the browser is using the fido-u2f format.
     * @return string
     * @throws WebAuthnException
     */
    public function getAAGUID() {
        if (!($this->_attestedCredentialData instanceof \stdClass)) {
            throw  new WebAuthnException('credential data not included in authenticator data', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }
        return $this->_attestedCredentialData->aaguid;
    }

    /**
     * returns the authenticatorData as binary
     * @return string
     */
    public function getBinary() {
        return $this->_binary;
    }

    /**
     * returns the credentialId
     * @return string
     * @throws WebAuthnException
     */
    public function getCredentialId() {
        if (!($this->_attestedCredentialData instanceof \stdClass)) {
            throw  new WebAuthnException('credential id not included in authenticator data', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }
        return $this->_attestedCredentialData->credentialId;
    }

    /**
     * returns the public key in PEM format
     * @return string
     */
    public function getPublicKeyPem() {
        $der = null;
        switch ($this->_attestedCredentialData->credentialPublicKey->kty) {
            case self::$_EC2_TYPE: $der = $this->_getEc2Der(); break;
            case self::$_RSA_TYPE: $der = $this->_getRsaDer(); break;
            default: throw new WebAuthnException('invalid key type', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        $pem = '-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----' . "\n";
        $pem .= \chunk_split(\base64_encode($der), 64, "\n");
        $pem .= '-----END PUBLIC KEY-----' . "\n";
        return $pem;
    }

    /**
     * returns the public key in U2F format
     * @return string
     * @throws WebAuthnException
     */
    public function getPublicKeyU2F() {
        if (!($this->_attestedCredentialData instanceof \stdClass)) {
            throw  new WebAuthnException('credential data not included in authenticator data', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }
        return "\x04" . // ECC uncompressed
                $this->_attestedCredentialData->credentialPublicKey->x .
                $this->_attestedCredentialData->credentialPublicKey->y;
    }

    /**
     * returns the SHA256 hash of the relying party id (=hostname)
     * @return string
     */
    public function getRpIdHash() {
        return $this->_rpIdHash;
    }

    /**
     * returns the sign counter
     * @return int
     */
    public function getSignCount() {
        return $this->_signCount;
    }

    /**
     * returns true if the user is present
     * @return boolean
     */
    public function getUserPresent() {
        return $this->_flags->userPresent;
    }

    /**
     * returns true if the user is verified
     * @return boolean
     */
    public function getUserVerified() {
        return $this->_flags->userVerified;
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------
    // PRIVATE
    // -----------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Returns DER encoded EC2 key
     * @return string
     */
    private function _getEc2Der() {
        return $this->_der_sequence(
            $this->_der_sequence(
                $this->_der_oid("\x2A\x86\x48\xCE\x3D\x02\x01") . // OID 1.2.840.10045.2.1 ecPublicKey
                $this->_der_oid("\x2A\x86\x48\xCE\x3D\x03\x01\x07")  // 1.2.840.10045.3.1.7 prime256v1
            ) .
            $this->_der_bitString($this->getPublicKeyU2F())
        );
    }

    /**
     * Returns DER encoded RSA key
     * @return string
     */
    private function _getRsaDer() {
        return $this->_der_sequence(
            $this->_der_sequence(
                $this->_der_oid("\x2A\x86\x48\x86\xF7\x0D\x01\x01\x01") . // OID 1.2.840.113549.1.1.1 rsaEncryption
                $this->_der_nullValue()
            ) .
            $this->_der_bitString(
                $this->_der_sequence(
                    $this->_der_unsignedInteger($this->_attestedCredentialData->credentialPublicKey->n) .
                    $this->_der_unsignedInteger($this->_attestedCredentialData->credentialPublicKey->e)
                )
            )
        );
    }

    /**
     * reads the flags from flag byte
     * @param string $binFlag
     * @return \stdClass
     */
    private function _readFlags($binFlag) {
        $flags = new \stdClass();

        $flags->bit_0 = !!($binFlag & 1);
        $flags->bit_1 = !!($binFlag & 2);
        $flags->bit_2 = !!($binFlag & 4);
        $flags->bit_3 = !!($binFlag & 8);
        $flags->bit_4 = !!($binFlag & 16);
        $flags->bit_5 = !!($binFlag & 32);
        $flags->bit_6 = !!($binFlag & 64);
        $flags->bit_7 = !!($binFlag & 128);

        // named flags
        $flags->userPresent = $flags->bit_0;
        $flags->userVerified = $flags->bit_2;
        $flags->attestedDataIncluded = $flags->bit_6;
        $flags->extensionDataIncluded = $flags->bit_7;
        return $flags;
    }

    /**
     * read attested data
     * @param string $binary
     * @param int $endOffset
     * @return \stdClass
     * @throws WebAuthnException
     */
    private function _readAttestData($binary, &$endOffset) {
        $attestedCData = new \stdClass();
        if (\strlen($binary) <= 55) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('Attested data should be present but is missing', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        // The AAGUID of the authenticator
        $attestedCData->aaguid = \substr($binary, 37, 16);

        //Byte length L of Credential ID, 16-bit unsigned big-endian integer.
        $length = \unpack('nlength', \substr($binary, 53, 2))['length'];
        $attestedCData->credentialId = \substr($binary, 55, $length);

        // set end offset
        $endOffset = 55 + $length;

        // extract public key
        $attestedCData->credentialPublicKey = $this->_readCredentialPublicKey($binary, 55 + $length, $endOffset);

        return $attestedCData;
    }

    /**
     * reads COSE key-encoded elliptic curve public key in EC2 format
     * @param string $binary
     * @param int $endOffset
     * @return \stdClass
     * @throws WebAuthnException
     */
    private function _readCredentialPublicKey($binary, $offset, &$endOffset) {
        $enc = CborDecoder::decodeInPlace($binary, $offset, $endOffset);

        // COSE key-encoded elliptic curve public key in EC2 format
        $credPKey = new \stdClass();
        $credPKey->kty = $enc[self::$_COSE_KTY];
        $credPKey->alg = $enc[self::$_COSE_ALG];

        switch ($credPKey->alg) {
            case self::$_EC2_ES256: $this->_readCredentialPublicKeyES256($credPKey, $enc); break;
            case self::$_RSA_RS256: $this->_readCredentialPublicKeyRS256($credPKey, $enc); break;
        }

        return $credPKey;
    }

    /**
     * extract ES256 informations from cose
     * @param \stdClass $credPKey
     * @param \stdClass $enc
     * @throws WebAuthnException
     */
    private function _readCredentialPublicKeyES256(&$credPKey, $enc) {
        $credPKey->crv = $enc[self::$_COSE_CRV];
        $credPKey->x   = $enc[self::$_COSE_X] instanceof ByteBuffer ? $enc[self::$_COSE_X]->getBinaryString() : null;
        $credPKey->y   = $enc[self::$_COSE_Y] instanceof ByteBuffer ? $enc[self::$_COSE_Y]->getBinaryString() : null;
        unset ($enc);

        // Validation
        if ($credPKey->kty !== self::$_EC2_TYPE) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('public key not in EC2 format', WebAuthnException::INVALID_PUBLIC_KEY);
        }

        if ($credPKey->alg !== self::$_EC2_ES256) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('signature algorithm not ES256', WebAuthnException::INVALID_PUBLIC_KEY);
        }

        if ($credPKey->crv !== self::$_EC2_P256) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('curve not P-256', WebAuthnException::INVALID_PUBLIC_KEY);
        }

        if (\strlen($credPKey->x) !== 32) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('Invalid X-coordinate', WebAuthnException::INVALID_PUBLIC_KEY);
        }

        if (\strlen($credPKey->y) !== 32) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('Invalid Y-coordinate', WebAuthnException::INVALID_PUBLIC_KEY);
        }
    }

    /**
     * extract RS256 informations from COSE
     * @param \stdClass $credPKey
     * @param \stdClass $enc
     * @throws WebAuthnException
     */
    private function _readCredentialPublicKeyRS256(&$credPKey, $enc) {
        $credPKey->n = $enc[self::$_COSE_N] instanceof ByteBuffer ? $enc[self::$_COSE_N]->getBinaryString() : null;
        $credPKey->e = $enc[self::$_COSE_E] instanceof ByteBuffer ? $enc[self::$_COSE_E]->getBinaryString() : null;
        unset ($enc);

        // Validation
        if ($credPKey->kty !== self::$_RSA_TYPE) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('public key not in RSA format', WebAuthnException::INVALID_PUBLIC_KEY);
        }

        if ($credPKey->alg !== self::$_RSA_RS256) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('signature algorithm not ES256', WebAuthnException::INVALID_PUBLIC_KEY);
        }

        if (\strlen($credPKey->n) !== 256) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('Invalid RSA modulus', WebAuthnException::INVALID_PUBLIC_KEY);
        }

        if (\strlen($credPKey->e) !== 3) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('Invalid RSA public exponent', WebAuthnException::INVALID_PUBLIC_KEY);
        }

    }

    /**
     * reads cbor encoded extension data.
     * @param string $binary
     * @return array
     * @throws WebAuthnException
     */
    private function _readExtensionData($binary) {
        $ext = CborDecoder::decode($binary);
        if (!\is_array($ext)) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid extension data', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        return $ext;
    }


    // ---------------
    // DER functions
    // ---------------

    private function _der_length($len) {
        if ($len < 128) {
            return \chr($len);
        }
        $lenBytes = '';
        while ($len > 0) {
            $lenBytes = \chr($len % 256) . $lenBytes;
            $len = \intdiv($len, 256);
        }
        return \chr(0x80 | \strlen($lenBytes)) . $lenBytes;
    }

    private function _der_sequence($contents) {
        return "\x30" . $this->_der_length(\strlen($contents)) . $contents;
    }

    private function _der_oid($encoded) {
        return "\x06" . $this->_der_length(\strlen($encoded)) . $encoded;
    }

    private function _der_bitString($bytes) {
        return "\x03" . $this->_der_length(\strlen($bytes) + 1) . "\x00" . $bytes;
    }

    private function _der_nullValue() {
        return "\x05\x00";
    }

    private function _der_unsignedInteger($bytes) {
        $len = \strlen($bytes);

        // Remove leading zero bytes
        for ($i = 0; $i < ($len - 1); $i++) {
            if (\ord($bytes[$i]) !== 0) {
                break;
            }
        }
        if ($i !== 0) {
            $bytes = \substr($bytes, $i);
        }

        // If most significant bit is set, prefix with another zero to prevent it being seen as negative number
        if ((\ord($bytes[0]) & 0x80) !== 0) {
            $bytes = "\x00" . $bytes;
        }

        return "\x02" . $this->_der_length(\strlen($bytes)) . $bytes;
    }
}

namespace lbuchs\WebAuthn\Attestation\Format;
use lbuchs\WebAuthn\Attestation\AuthenticatorData;
use lbuchs\WebAuthn\WebAuthnException;
use lbuchs\WebAuthn\Binary\ByteBuffer;

class AndroidKey extends FormatBase {
    private $_alg;
    private $_signature;
    private $_x5c;

    public function __construct($AttestionObject, AuthenticatorData $authenticatorData) {
        parent::__construct($AttestionObject, $authenticatorData);

        // check u2f data
        $attStmt = $this->_attestationObject['attStmt'];

        if (!\array_key_exists('alg', $attStmt) || $this->_getCoseAlgorithm($attStmt['alg']) === null) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('unsupported alg: ' . $attStmt['alg'], WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        if (!\array_key_exists('sig', $attStmt) || !\is_object($attStmt['sig']) || !($attStmt['sig'] instanceof ByteBuffer)) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('no signature found', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        if (!\array_key_exists('x5c', $attStmt) || !\is_array($attStmt['x5c']) || \count($attStmt['x5c']) < 1) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid x5c certificate', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        if (!\is_object($attStmt['x5c'][0]) || !($attStmt['x5c'][0] instanceof ByteBuffer)) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid x5c certificate', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        $this->_alg = $attStmt['alg'];
        $this->_signature = $attStmt['sig']->getBinaryString();
        $this->_x5c = $attStmt['x5c'][0]->getBinaryString();

        if (count($attStmt['x5c']) > 1) {
            for ($i=1; $i<count($attStmt['x5c']); $i++) {
                $this->_x5c_chain[] = $attStmt['x5c'][$i]->getBinaryString();
            }
            unset ($i);
        }
    }


    /*
     * returns the key certificate in PEM format
     * @return string
     */
    public function getCertificatePem() {
        return $this->_createCertificatePem($this->_x5c);
    }

    /**
     * @param string $clientDataHash
     */
    public function validateAttestation($clientDataHash) {
        $publicKey = \openssl_pkey_get_public($this->getCertificatePem());

        if ($publicKey === false) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid public key: ' . \openssl_error_string(), WebAuthnException::INVALID_PUBLIC_KEY);
        }

        // Verify that sig is a valid signature over the concatenation of authenticatorData and clientDataHash
        // using the attestation public key in attestnCert with the algorithm specified in alg.
        $dataToVerify = $this->_authenticatorData->getBinary();
        $dataToVerify .= $clientDataHash;

        $coseAlgorithm = $this->_getCoseAlgorithm($this->_alg);

        // check certificate
        return \openssl_verify($dataToVerify, $this->_signature, $publicKey, $coseAlgorithm->openssl) === 1;
    }

    /**
     * validates the certificate against root certificates
     * @param array $rootCas
     * @return boolean
     * @throws WebAuthnException
     */
    public function validateRootCertificate($rootCas) {
        $chainC = $this->_createX5cChainFile();
        if ($chainC) {
            $rootCas[] = $chainC;
        }

        $v = \openssl_x509_checkpurpose($this->getCertificatePem(), -1, $rootCas);
        if ($v === -1) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('error on validating root certificate: ' . \openssl_error_string(), WebAuthnException::CERTIFICATE_NOT_TRUSTED);
        }
        return $v;
    }
}

namespace lbuchs\WebAuthn\Attestation\Format;
use lbuchs\WebAuthn\Attestation\AuthenticatorData;
use lbuchs\WebAuthn\WebAuthnException;
use lbuchs\WebAuthn\Binary\ByteBuffer;

class AndroidSafetyNet extends FormatBase {
    private $_signature;
    private $_signedValue;
    private $_x5c;
    private $_payload;

    public function __construct($AttestionObject, AuthenticatorData $authenticatorData) {
        parent::__construct($AttestionObject, $authenticatorData);

        // check data
        $attStmt = $this->_attestationObject['attStmt'];

        if (!\array_key_exists('ver', $attStmt) || !$attStmt['ver']) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid Android Safety Net Format', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        if (!\array_key_exists('response', $attStmt) || !($attStmt['response'] instanceof ByteBuffer)) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid Android Safety Net Format', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        $response = $attStmt['response']->getBinaryString();

        // Response is a JWS [RFC7515] object in Compact Serialization.
        // JWSs have three segments separated by two period ('.') characters
        $parts = \explode('.', $response);
        unset ($response);
        if (\count($parts) !== 3) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid JWS data', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        $header = $this->_base64url_decode($parts[0]);
        $payload = $this->_base64url_decode($parts[1]);
        $this->_signature = $this->_base64url_decode($parts[2]);
        $this->_signedValue = $parts[0] . '.' . $parts[1];
        unset ($parts);

        $header = \json_decode($header);
        $payload = \json_decode($payload);

        if (!($header instanceof \stdClass)) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid JWS header', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }
        if (!($payload instanceof \stdClass)) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid JWS payload', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        if (!$header->x5c || !is_array($header->x5c) || count($header->x5c) === 0) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('No X.509 signature in JWS Header', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        // algorithm
        if (!\in_array($header->alg, array('RS256', 'ES256'))) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid JWS algorithm ' . $header->alg, WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        $this->_x5c = \base64_decode($header->x5c[0]);
        $this->_payload = $payload;

        if (count($header->x5c) > 1) {
            for ($i=1; $i<count($header->x5c); $i++) {
                $this->_x5c_chain[] = \base64_decode($header->x5c[$i]);
            }
            unset ($i);
        }
    }


    /*
     * returns the key certificate in PEM format
     * @return string
     */
    public function getCertificatePem() {
        return $this->_createCertificatePem($this->_x5c);
    }

    /**
     * @param string $clientDataHash
     */
    public function validateAttestation($clientDataHash) {
        $publicKey = \openssl_pkey_get_public($this->getCertificatePem());

        // Verify that the nonce in the response is identical to the Base64 encoding
        // of the SHA-256 hash of the concatenation of authenticatorData and clientDataHash.
        if (!$this->_payload->nonce || $this->_payload->nonce !== \base64_encode(\hash('SHA256', $this->_authenticatorData->getBinary() . $clientDataHash, true))) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid nonce in JWS payload', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        // Verify that attestationCert is issued to the hostname "attest.android.com"
        $certInfo = \openssl_x509_parse($this->getCertificatePem());
        if (!\is_array($certInfo) || !$certInfo['subject'] || $certInfo['subject']['CN'] !== 'attest.android.com') {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid certificate CN in JWS (' . $certInfo['subject']['CN']. ')', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        // Verify that the ctsProfileMatch attribute in the payload of response is true.
        if (!$this->_payload->ctsProfileMatch) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid ctsProfileMatch in payload', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        // check certificate
        return \openssl_verify($this->_signedValue, $this->_signature, $publicKey, OPENSSL_ALGO_SHA256) === 1;
    }


    /**
     * validates the certificate against root certificates
     * @param array $rootCas
     * @return boolean
     * @throws WebAuthnException
     */
    public function validateRootCertificate($rootCas) {
        $chainC = $this->_createX5cChainFile();
        if ($chainC) {
            $rootCas[] = $chainC;
        }

        $v = \openssl_x509_checkpurpose($this->getCertificatePem(), -1, $rootCas);
        if ($v === -1) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('error on validating root certificate: ' . \openssl_error_string(), WebAuthnException::CERTIFICATE_NOT_TRUSTED);
        }
        return $v;
    }


    /**
     * decode base64 url
     * @param string $data
     * @return string
     */
    private function _base64url_decode($data) {
        return \base64_decode(\strtr($data, '-_', '+/') . \str_repeat('=', 3 - (3 + \strlen($data)) % 4));
    }
}

namespace lbuchs\WebAuthn\Attestation\Format;
use lbuchs\WebAuthn\Attestation\AuthenticatorData;
use lbuchs\WebAuthn\WebAuthnException;
use lbuchs\WebAuthn\Binary\ByteBuffer;

class Apple extends FormatBase {
    private $_x5c;

    public function __construct($AttestionObject, AuthenticatorData $authenticatorData) {
        parent::__construct($AttestionObject, $authenticatorData);

        // check packed data
        $attStmt = $this->_attestationObject['attStmt'];


        // certificate for validation
        if (\array_key_exists('x5c', $attStmt) && \is_array($attStmt['x5c']) && \count($attStmt['x5c']) > 0) {

            // The attestation certificate attestnCert MUST be the first element in the array
            $attestnCert = array_shift($attStmt['x5c']);

            if (!($attestnCert instanceof ByteBuffer)) {
                throw new WebAuthnException('invalid x5c certificate', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
            }

            $this->_x5c = $attestnCert->getBinaryString();

            // certificate chain
            foreach ($attStmt['x5c'] as $chain) {
                if ($chain instanceof ByteBuffer) {
                    $this->_x5c_chain[] = $chain->getBinaryString();
                }
            }
        } else {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid Apple attestation statement: missing x5c', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }
    }


    /*
     * returns the key certificate in PEM format
     * @return string|null
     */
    public function getCertificatePem() {
        return $this->_createCertificatePem($this->_x5c);
    }

    /**
     * @param string $clientDataHash
     */
    public function validateAttestation($clientDataHash) {
        return $this->_validateOverX5c($clientDataHash);
    }

    /**
     * validates the certificate against root certificates
     * @param array $rootCas
     * @return boolean
     * @throws WebAuthnException
     */
    public function validateRootCertificate($rootCas) {
        $chainC = $this->_createX5cChainFile();
        if ($chainC) {
            $rootCas[] = $chainC;
        }

        $v = \openssl_x509_checkpurpose($this->getCertificatePem(), -1, $rootCas);
        if ($v === -1) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('error on validating root certificate: ' . \openssl_error_string(), WebAuthnException::CERTIFICATE_NOT_TRUSTED);
        }
        return $v;
    }

    /**
     * validate if x5c is present
     * @param string $clientDataHash
     * @return bool
     * @throws WebAuthnException
     */
    protected function _validateOverX5c($clientDataHash) {
        $publicKey = \openssl_pkey_get_public($this->getCertificatePem());

        if ($publicKey === false) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid public key: ' . \openssl_error_string(), WebAuthnException::INVALID_PUBLIC_KEY);
        }

        // Concatenate authenticatorData and clientDataHash to form nonceToHash.
        $nonceToHash = $this->_authenticatorData->getBinary();
        $nonceToHash .= $clientDataHash;

        // Perform SHA-256 hash of nonceToHash to produce nonce
        $nonce = hash('SHA256', $nonceToHash, true);

        $credCert = openssl_x509_read($this->getCertificatePem());
        if ($credCert === false) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('invalid x5c certificate: ' . \openssl_error_string(), WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        $keyData = openssl_pkey_get_details(openssl_pkey_get_public($credCert));
        $key = is_array($keyData) && array_key_exists('key', $keyData) ? $keyData['key'] : null;


        // Verify that nonce equals the value of the extension with OID ( 1.2.840.113635.100.8.2 ) in credCert.
        $parsedCredCert = openssl_x509_parse($credCert);
        $nonceExtension = isset($parsedCredCert['extensions']['1.2.840.113635.100.8.2']) ? $parsedCredCert['extensions']['1.2.840.113635.100.8.2'] : '';

        // nonce padded by ASN.1 string: 30 24 A1 22 04 20
        // 30     — type tag indicating sequence
        // 24     — 36 byte following
        //   A1   — Enumerated [1]
        //   22   — 34 byte following
        //     04 — type tag indicating octet string
        //     20 — 32 byte following

        $asn1Padding = "\x30\x24\xA1\x22\x04\x20";
        if (substr($nonceExtension, 0, strlen($asn1Padding)) === $asn1Padding) {
            $nonceExtension = substr($nonceExtension, strlen($asn1Padding));
        }

        if ($nonceExtension !== $nonce) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('nonce doesn\'t equal the value of the extension with OID 1.2.840.113635.100.8.2', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        // Verify that the credential public key equals the Subject Public Key of credCert.
        $authKeyData = openssl_pkey_get_details(openssl_pkey_get_public($this->_authenticatorData->getPublicKeyPem()));
        $authKey = is_array($authKeyData) && array_key_exists('key', $authKeyData) ? $authKeyData['key'] : null;

        if ($key === null || $key !== $authKey) {
            throw new WebAuthnException('credential public key doesn\'t equal the Subject Public Key of credCert', WebAuthnException::INVALID_DATA);
        }

        return true;
    }

}

namespace lbuchs\WebAuthn\Attestation\Format;
use lbuchs\WebAuthn\WebAuthnException;
use lbuchs\WebAuthn\Attestation\AuthenticatorData;


abstract class FormatBase {
    protected $_attestationObject = null;
    protected $_authenticatorData = null;
    protected $_x5c_chain = array();
    protected $_x5c_tempFile = null;

    /**
     *
     * @param Array $AttestionObject
     * @param AuthenticatorData $authenticatorData
     */
    public function __construct($AttestionObject, AuthenticatorData $authenticatorData) {
        $this->_attestationObject = $AttestionObject;
        $this->_authenticatorData = $authenticatorData;
    }

    /**
     *
     */
    public function __destruct() {
        // delete X.509 chain certificate file after use
        if ($this->_x5c_tempFile && \is_file($this->_x5c_tempFile)) {
            \unlink($this->_x5c_tempFile);
        }
    }

    /**
     * returns the certificate chain in PEM format
     * @return string|null
     */
    public function getCertificateChain() {
        if ($this->_x5c_tempFile && \is_file($this->_x5c_tempFile)) {
            return \file_get_contents($this->_x5c_tempFile);
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * returns the key X.509 certificate in PEM format
     * @return string
     */
    public function getCertificatePem() {
        // need to be overwritten
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * checks validity of the signature
     * @param string $clientDataHash
     * @return bool
     * @throws WebAuthnException
     */
    public function validateAttestation($clientDataHash) {
        // need to be overwritten
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * validates the certificate against root certificates
     * @param array $rootCas
     * @return boolean
     * @throws WebAuthnException
     */
    public function validateRootCertificate($rootCas) {
        // need to be overwritten
        return false;
    }


    /**
     * create a PEM encoded certificate with X.509 binary data
     * @param string $x5c
     * @return string
     */
    protected function _createCertificatePem($x5c) {
        $pem = '-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----' . "\n";
        $pem .= \chunk_split(\base64_encode($x5c), 64, "\n");
        $pem .= '-----END CERTIFICATE-----' . "\n";
        return $pem;
    }

    /**
     * creates a PEM encoded chain file
     * @return type
     */
    protected function _createX5cChainFile() {
        $content = '';
        if (\is_array($this->_x5c_chain) && \count($this->_x5c_chain) > 0) {
            foreach ($this->_x5c_chain as $x5c) {
                $certInfo = \openssl_x509_parse($this->_createCertificatePem($x5c));
                // check if issuer = subject (self signed)
                if (\is_array($certInfo) && \is_array($certInfo['issuer']) && \is_array($certInfo['subject'])) {
                    $selfSigned = true;
                    foreach ($certInfo['issuer'] as $k => $v) {
                        if ($certInfo['subject'][$k] !== $v) {
                            $selfSigned = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }

                    if (!$selfSigned) {
                        $content .= "\n" . $this->_createCertificatePem($x5c) . "\n";
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if ($content) {
            $this->_x5c_tempFile = \sys_get_temp_dir() . '/x5c_chain_' . \base_convert(\rand(), 10, 36) . '.pem';
            if (\file_put_contents($this->_x5c_tempFile, $content) !== false) {
                return $this->_x5c_tempFile;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }


    /**
     * returns the name and openssl key for provided cose number.
     * @param int $coseNumber
     * @return \stdClass|null
     */
    protected function _getCoseAlgorithm($coseNumber) {
        // https://www.iana.org/assignments/cose/cose.xhtml#algorithms
        $coseAlgorithms = array(
            array(
                'hash' => 'SHA1',
                'openssl' => OPENSSL_ALGO_SHA1,
                'cose' => array(
                    -65535  // RS1
                )),

            array(
                'hash' => 'SHA256',
                'openssl' => OPENSSL_ALGO_SHA256,
                'cose' => array(
                    -257, // RS256
                    -37,  // PS256
                    -7,   // ES256
                    5     // HMAC256
                )),

            array(
                'hash' => 'SHA384',
                'openssl' => OPENSSL_ALGO_SHA384,
                'cose' => array(
                    -258, // RS384
                    -38,  // PS384
                    -35,  // ES384
                    6     // HMAC384
                )),

            array(
                'hash' => 'SHA512',
                'openssl' => OPENSSL_ALGO_SHA512,
                'cose' => array(
                    -259, // RS512
                    -39,  // PS512
                    -36,  // ES512
                    7     // HMAC512
                ))
        );

        foreach ($coseAlgorithms as $coseAlgorithm) {
            if (\in_array($coseNumber, $coseAlgorithm['cose'], true)) {
                $return = new \stdClass();
                $return->hash = $coseAlgorithm['hash'];
                $return->openssl = $coseAlgorithm['openssl'];
                return $return;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }
}
